description: This file implements precision emulation helpers for shader translation, including classes for generating rounding helper functions for GLSL, ESSL, and HLSL, and a class EmulatePrecision that traverses shader AST nodes to insert rounding operations where needed.

classes.name: RoundingHelperWriter
classes.description: Abstract base class for generating rounding helper functions for different shader languages.

classes.name: RoundingHelperWriterGLSL
classes.description: Generates rounding helper functions for GLSL.

classes.name: RoundingHelperWriterESSL
classes.description: Generates rounding helper functions for ESSL, inherits from GLSL implementation.

classes.name: RoundingHelperWriterHLSL
classes.description: Generates rounding helper functions for HLSL.

classes.name: EmulatePrecision
classes.description: AST traverser that inserts precision emulation code into shader AST nodes, including rounding functions and handling of binary/unary operations.

methods.name: createHelperWriter
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate RoundingHelperWriter based on output language.

methods.name: writeCommonRoundingHelpers
methods.description: Writes common rounding helper functions for a given shader version.

methods.name: writeCompoundAssignmentHelper
methods.description: Writes helper functions for compound assignment operations.

methods.name: getTypeString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a GLSL type, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: writeFloatRoundingHelpers
methods.description: Writes rounding helpers for float types.

methods.name: writeVectorRoundingHelpers
methods.description: Writes rounding helpers for vector types.

methods.name: writeMatrixRoundingHelper
methods.description: Writes rounding helper for matrix types.

methods.name: SupportedInLanguage
methods.description: Checks if precision emulation is supported in the given shader output language.

methods.name: getInternalFunction
methods.description: Retrieves or creates internal functions used for rounding and compound operations.

methods.name: createRoundingFunctionCallNode
methods.description: Creates a function call node for rounding a given AST node.

methods.name: createCompoundAssignmentFunctionCallNode
methods.description: Creates a function call node for compound assignment operations.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Visits symbol nodes to insert rounding if needed.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits binary nodes to insert rounding or replace with function calls.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles aggregate nodes, possibly inserting rounding for return values.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Handles unary nodes, inserting rounding where appropriate.

methods.name: writeEmulationHelpers
methods.description: Outputs the helper functions for rounding and precision emulation.
